name: South Sudan

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of black, red and green separated by narrow white stripes, with a blue triangle at the hoist bearing a yellow five-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: Black represents the people, red the blood shed for freedom, green the land, white peace and blue the waters of the Nile; the yellow star stands for unity.

hook: South Sudan is Kenya's black-red-green stripes with a blue Nile triangle and gold star at the hoist instead of a shield.
trivia: The flag was used by the autonomous region from 2005 and became the national flag at independence in 2011.
South Sudan, admitted in July 2011, is the newest member of the United Nations.
The Sudd in South Sudan is one of the largest wetlands in the world.
